description:
Flixor: A Smarter Way to Choose What to Watch

Flixor uses advanced AI to deliver fast, highly personalized movie and TV recommendations. Simply describe your mood, a specific vibe, or your viewing context, and our AI finds the perfect match.

How to Use in ChatGPT

Setup: Connect Flixor to ChatGPT.
Trigger: Activate the app using either of these methods:
-Type “@” and select Flixor from the menu.
-Type “Flixor” directly in the chat box.

defaultPrompt: I'm feeling a bit down. Can you recommend?
I really enjoyed Inception. What else should l watch_
